label: Concurrent actualization from its begun and homogeneous restrictions and coverage (inference)
rule: Split a present received-esse thing by the coverage premise and apply the matching restriction
meaning: Let x have its esse received in z and be present at t in history v. The coverage premise gives either a first moment b of x's presence in v, or homogeneity of x in v relative to the supplied facts. In the first case the begun restriction f4850897 gives something that gives x being at t. In the second case the homogeneous restriction eb928359, for the same giving relation and facts, gives the same. That is weak concurrent actualization 40a97664, on the STRICT esse-giving reading of GivesAt (definition 158301bc), in every history of the model. What is derived and what is supplied: both restrictions are supplied premises here; f4850897 is itself obtained from onset fa3e228b and parity 5b24ef26 by a transcription, and parity given onset is the begun restriction restated, so the begun half adds no warrant beyond parity's; eb928359 is derived from coverage, exercise and time symmetry, and its new content is for homogeneous things without a first moment. Both restrictions are also entailed by 40a97664 (registered strength orders); those supports run back through the conclusion and add no warrant here, so the route's non-circular support is onset and parity for f4850897 and coverage, exercise and time symmetry for eb928359. The coverage premise is a structural claim about histories, with no giving in it. Each premise is needed (controls, parts 1 to 3: the omitted premise fails, the other two hold, 40a97664 fails), and the three together are strictly stronger than 40a97664 (part 4). The companion nonvacuity populates the bundle: in the eternal history with no supplied facts and giving at every moment, the received-esse thing false is present at moment 0 and all three premises and 40a97664 hold. So the route does not discharge the crux: it fills the gap named in the strong_version_needed of 366a6ea3 (things with no first moment of presence) for homogeneous things only, and leaves as an explicit open premise that no received-esse thing is beginningless and changing. Where a history rules out the automorphisms homogeneity needs, that premise says each received-esse thing present at two or more moments there began. All premises stay open.
